# 詩本音

**ID:** KR1j0079
**Custom ID:** ZB1j0074

**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V241.2, p33
**Extent:** 10 卷
**Base edition:** WYG

## Authors / Editors
- 顧炎武 (清朝) 撰 1613 - 1682

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

Gù Yánwǔ's systematic working-through of the *Shījīng* in the light of Chén Dì's [陳第](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%99%B3%E7%AC%AC) *Máo Shī gǔyīn kǎo* [KR1j0072](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0072) doctrine that the *Shī* has no *xiéyùn* but only its own native (*běn*) phonology. 10 *juàn*. Each *Shī* poem is given in full, with a reading-gloss under each line: where the rhyme-character's reading agrees with the *Guǎngyùn*, the gloss is "*Guǎngyùn mǒu bù*" (in *Guǎngyùn* class X); where it differs, the gloss is "*gǔyīn mǒu*" (Old reading X). The book is therefore both a *Shī*-text edition and a complete reference for Gù's reconstructed Old phonology of the *Shī*. The Sìkù *tíyào* is candid: Gù's analysis is denser than Chén Dì's but somewhat less subtle than Jiāng Yǒng's [江永](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%9F%E6%B0%B8) later *Gǔyùn biāozhǔn* [KR1j0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0087) (1759), which corrects many of Gù's specific assignments — yet the methodological frame remains Gù's, and Jiāng Yǒng's book "supports this book; cannot replace this book." Máo Qílíng's [毛奇齡](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AF%9B%E5%A5%87%E9%BD%A1) hostile critique (in his *Gǔjīn tōngyùn* [KR1j0084](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0084)) is dismissed by the Sìkù compilers as factional rivalry rather than substantive argument.

**Abstract**

The *Shī běnyīn* (1643–1667) is Gù Yánwǔ's systematic application of Chén Dì's *xiéyùn*-rejecting methodology to the *Shījīng* — a complete *Shī* edition with Old phonological reading marked at every rhyme-character. Methodologically the second cornerstone of the *Yīnxué wǔshū* (after the theoretical *Yīn lùn* [KR1j0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0078)); used by Lǐ Guāngdì [李光地](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9D%8E%E5%85%89%E5%9C%B0) in his classical poetry-reading and effectively foundational to the Qīng *Shī* exegetical tradition. Modern phonology takes Gù's specific reconstructions as superseded — primarily by Jiāng Yǒng's [江永](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%9F%E6%B0%B8) *Gǔyùn biāozhǔn* [KR1j0087](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0087) (1759), which corrects many individual assignments — but the methodological commitment to native Old phonology runs unbroken through the entire Qīng tradition. *notBefore* = 1643; *notAfter* = 1667.
